title: Docs: the onboarding guide names a retired flag
body: `docs/onboarding.md` still documents `--legacy-mode`, removed two releases ago.

title: Importer silently drops rows once the batch size exceeds the page limit
body:
`importer.sh` pages the source in fixed windows. When `--batch-size` is larger than the page limit the tail of each window is discarded and the run still returns `exit 0`.

Related: #42.

title: Retry budget is consumed by connection errors that never reached the server
body: `retry.sh` counts a DNS failure against the same budget as a 500.
